title: WalkStreet - a GPS tycoon game that plays while your screen is off
author: VihmaVillu
selftext:
I'm a solo dev, and I just released my first game on Android!

Since this is r/aigamedev, I wanted to share the stack and how I got this built. I used the Claude Opus models in VS code and it took about 3 months total.   
   
Tech stack:  
\* SvelteKit + Capacitor for the Android/iOS apps  
\* PostgreSQL for the database  
\* MapLibre for the 2D map  
\* Three.js for the 3D elements.

WalkStreet is a tycoon game played on the real-world map. You buy real buildings around you - start with something small like your backyard shed, then keep reinvesting and upgrading until it's a glass skyscraper. Everything you build shows up on the map for other players too, so you're not just growing a portfolio, you're slowly reshaping the world everyone walks through.

What started as a simple "buy buildings" idea turned into a strategy tycoon game. Where you have districts to grow, building types that synergize, an economy you keep healthy, trips, battles, leaderboards, memory lane photos, stamp collections and hostile takeovers...

For now the game is FREE and no ads.   
Monetization will probably be for the cosmetics, but never with ads!   
Battery life friendly!

Play Store:[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.walkstreet.app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.walkstreet.app)

  
App Store (testflight): [https://testflight.apple.com/join/4r2dTpSt](https://testflight.apple.com/join/4r2dTpSt)

  
Website:[https://walkstreetgame.com](https://walkstreetgame.com)

  
**Takeaways**:

*  [CLAUDE.md](http://CLAUDE.md) rules are a must! Got about 20 rules + guidelines and best practises
* [Readme.md](http://Readme.md) is a must, from there I have linked about 20 specific MD files
* Keep files max 200 lines
* AI response always must include: what to do next, refactoring opportunities, tech debt, tldr - add them to your rules
* Always after every feature I run 1-2 audits in the end. Aka "run full audit on the changes. Do not assume - verify every word" 
* Every week if I have tokens left, I run systematic audits and make sure all MD files are up to date
* Use all kinds of testing, unit tests, lint tests etc. They are cheap and fast way to make sure to eliminate at least some portion of bugs 

  


I've been webdev for 20+ years but this is my first game.  
Happy to answer questions
